name: decentralized-sum-of-nonconvex-theory-v1
title: 去中心化有限和 sum-of-nonconvex 强凸复合优化的迭代复杂度（纯理论，theory-v1）
status_reason: Theory-only task (user decision 2026-11-27): OptBound ULB-profile-63, an open oracle-complexity problem. Human results checked against the sources: upper bound Liu-Low (AAAI 2024, arXiv:2402.02356v1, Theorem 5.1 and Corollary 5.3); no lower bound for the class (OptBound lists it as unknown); transferable lower bounds Woodworth-Srebro 2016 Theorem 8 and Scaman et al. 2017 Theorem 2; the n^{3/4}-type lower bound of Zhou-Gu 2019 Theorem 4.1 needs only average smoothness, and the component-smooth case is listed there as future work (and remains open for a related problem per arXiv:2611.05807). The formal model is fixed: Theory/Model.lean and Theory/Sanity.lean from the theory pilot's ULB-63 statement layer (definitions only), restored by the Lean check. Public internet during development through arena/netproxy.py, offline Lean v4.35 with Mathlib and CSLib, 8 GiB development container, single 6-hour session. Trial runs only; not on the board.

source.model: /data/workspace/frontieram-theory-pilot/optbound/ulb-63/lean/ULB63/Model.lean and Sanity.lean (headers and import path adapted)

task.note: the blackbox-cubature v3 task image (Python only), reused; development runs in its harness image frontieram-blackbox-cubature-v3-harness:v6, which adds the harness, git (for lake), curl and socat (for the proxy bridge)

lean.packages: mathlib v4.35.0 and cslib v4.35.0 with their dependencies, prebuilt (/data/workspace/frontieram-theory-pilot/lean/.lake/packages, mounted at /opt/lean-packages)
lean.check: scripts/grade/lean-comparator.py --fixed Theory/Model.lean=<workspace>/examples/lean_project/Theory/Model.lean --fixed Theory/Sanity.lean=<workspace>/examples/lean_project/Theory/Sanity.lean: lake comparator, Theory.Statements (challenge) against Theory.Proofs (solution), axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice

network.development: public internet through arena/netproxy.py (deny list in that module, including OptBound), requests logged to netproxy.jsonl in the run; provider-side web tools off

scoring.raw: per result: Lean check (lake comparator) and statement match; position in the partial order against the registered anchors (stronger / incomparable / dominated or equal) and, if incomparable, the registered value preferences
scoring.mapping: tiers (user decision 2026-11-27, replacing the 11-26 continuous mapping): only results accepted by lake comparator and judged to match THEORY.md count; each is placed in the partial order (assumptions x strength) against the human SOTA anchors registered before review (tasks/decentralized-sum-of-nonconvex/analysis/THEORY_ANCHORS.md): strictly stronger than a registered anchor and not dominated by any known human result 100; incomparable with all and meeting a registered value preference (from the human papers' own text) 50; incomparable otherwise 25; dominated by or equal to a known human result (restatement, special case) 10; score = maximum over verified results, 0 without any (tasks/blackbox-cubature/analysis/THEORY_REVIEW.md section 2)
scoring.theory: the only score of this task

submission_note: Put the theory document in /workspace/submission/theory/THEORY.md and its Lean formalization in /workspace/submission/theory/formal/ (start from /workspace/examples/lean_project/, whose Theory/Model.lean and Theory/Sanity.lean are the fixed problem model). There is no program to write.
instruction: Read /workspace/problem.md, /workspace/PROFILE.md and /workspace/MODEL_NOTES.md in full, and look at /workspace/tools and /workspace/examples. Write the theory document and its Lean formalization described there.
